Actor Aamir Khan marries Gauri Spratt in Mumbai

Actor Aamir Khan has married Gauri Spratt in Mumbai. Preparations for the wedding, including home decorations, were underway. The couple's marriage registration under the Special Marriage Act is reported to have taken place on July 5. Their friendship reportedly spans 25 years, and they reconnected two years ago to advance their relationship. Aamir Khan is described as becoming a groom for the third time. Former cricketer Irfan Pathan was seen attending the wedding ceremony.
